focal_claim_designation.rationale: The article states two hypotheses (D1 p5), foregrounds positive main associations in its abstract (D1 p2), and explicitly distinguishes support for H1 from lack of support for H2 in the discussion (D1 p18). C01 is the primary headline claim; C02 is a separate focal family with exploratory tests.
focal_claim_designation.aggregation_rule_proposal: Preserve both outcomes and both simultaneous main-effects specifications as distinct evidence cells. For H1, report direction and printed significance for all HRM slopes in Models 2/3 and 7/8, and the HRM joint tests; use Models 1/6 only as the stated isolation comparison. Do not require all practices to be significant and do not select the most favorable cell. The article supplies no numerical paper-level pass threshold, so no binary aggregation is identified. For H2, jointly report the four interaction-block tests, every interaction slope, and the unavailable count-model evidence; do not turn nonsignificance into proof of equivalence. This follows the joint and individual discussion in D1 pp15,17–18.
